title: Slovakian-Style Pork Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting German-inspired casserole loaded with tender pork, potatoes, and a medley of vegetables.
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the pork cubes over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the sliced sausage until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and carrots to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pork, sausage, onions, carrots, and sliced potatoes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and beer until smooth. Add the beef broth and whisk until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients over the pork mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and stir in the sour cream. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
